description: This file defines the `BedrockDataAutomationClient` class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating blueprints and data automation projects, as well as their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: BedrockDataAutomationClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS's Amazon Bedrock Data Automation service, extending the generic AwsClient to include specific API methods.

methods.name: createBlueprint
methods.description: Method to create a new blueprint in the Data Automation service.

methods.name: createBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of createBlueprint, returns a Promise.

methods.name: createBlueprintVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing blueprint.

methods.name: createDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Creates a new Data Automation project.

methods.name: deleteDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Deletes a specified Data Automation project.

methods.name: deleteDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous delete of a Data Automation project.

methods.name: getBlueprint
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific blueprint.

methods.name: getDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Gets details of a specific Data Automation project.

methods.name: updateDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Updates an existing Data Automation project.
